pairs.summary: EVX2 and PBX2 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 7 of 14 profiles analysed (HepG2 hepatoblastoma/liver cancer; K562 chronic myelogenous leukemia; Liscovitch-Brauer2021 K562 cells | K562; SW620 colorectal adenocarcinoma (metastasis); ...). Median lift 1.34x, typical spacing ~42 bp between sites. In 7 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction. Evidence: motif co-occurrence only (ChromBPNet not yet run for this pair).
